nav.zonesHint: Split chats into zones to isolate or share memory

groupContext.title: Group context
groupContext.desc: How many recent messages of the group Cyrene reads when replying there.
groupContext.hint: More messages mean better context but more tokens.

deleteAll.title: Delete all memory
deleteAll.desc: Erase everything Cyrene remembers about you: profile, event snippets, vector index, relationship log, entity graph, moments, group chat logs.
deleteAll.hint: Desktop chat history, stickers, settings and scheduled tasks are kept. This cannot be undone.
deleteAll.confirmMessage: This cannot be undone and will erase all of Cyrene's memory. Type "确认删除" to continue:
deleteAll.doneMessage: All memory has been deleted. Restart Cyrene to make it take effect.

manager.itemPeopleCounts: 🗣 Their memories {{own}} · 👥 Others mention them {{mentioned}} · total {{total}} · {{sessions}} source sessions
manager.empty: No memories in this view yet
manager.emptyHint: After chatting, Cyrene groups memories by person / zone / session
manager.groupAllHint: Zone / session views list memories per container; check rows to delete them one by one or in bulk.
manager.groupOwnHint: What they said and what is stored in their private chat — this is the group 「Erase completely」 deletes.
manager.groupMentionedHint: Memories where someone else mentioned them; kept by default. Deleting them also removes part of someone else's history.
manager.detailSummary: {{total}} total · 🗣 theirs {{own}} · 👥 mentioned by others {{mentioned}} · {{sessions}} source sessions
manager.deleteConfirmMessage: This deletes the memories inside the {{count}} selected containers and cascades into evidence, vectors, DMAE states and dangling references (in the people view this is 「their memories」; 「others mention them」 is kept by default). This cannot be undone.
manager.deleteDone: Deleted {{removed}} memories (evidence {{evidence}} · vectors {{vectors}} · DMAE states {{dmaeStates}} · conflict logs {{conflictLogs}} · dangling refs fixed {{danglingRefsFixed}})
manager.deletePartialFailed: {{failed}} containers failed; {{removed}} memories were deleted. You can retry.
manager.mentionedDeleteMessage: The {{count}} memories you selected are records of someone else mentioning them (speakers: {{speakers}}). Deleting them erases part of someone else's history. Continue?
manager.loadFailed: Failed to load the memory console
manager.loadFailedHint: Check the terminal log and retry
manager.traceMissing: Source unavailable (the messages were deleted or never written to the transcript)
manager.traceEmpty: This memory has no recorded source messages
manager.erasedFeedback: Erasure finished; the list has been refreshed

erase.planLead: About to erase the conversation and memory traces of 「{{name}}」 ({{key}}). The following will be deleted as soon as you confirm a second time:
erase.preservedLead: Kept on purpose (the erase never touches them, and they do not affect whether Cyrene knows them):
erase.willDelete: Will delete {{count}} memories (what they said / their private chat)
erase.willDeleteBreakdown: Breakdown: spoken by them {{speaker}} · from their private chat {{private}} · related summaries {{summaries}} ({{decompressed}} of them are de-compressed and their surviving sub-entries become active again)
erase.corpusUntouched: The group corpus is not touched at all (kept on purpose; it does not affect whether Cyrene knows them)
erase.sessionLine: {{sessionId}} ({{kind}}) · memories {{l2}} · hot {{hot}} lines · archive {{archive}} lines / {{months}} months · {{assistant}} of them are her replies mentioning him
erase.peripheralTitle: Peripheral stores cleaned at the same time
erase.peripheralLine: memory vectors {{vectors}} · conversation vectors {{chatVectors}} · evidence {{evidence}} · DMAE states {{dmae}} · conflict logs {{conflicts}} · reflection logs {{reflections}}
erase.relationshipLine: Relationship log (injected into the main chat every turn): by person {{byPersonKey}} · by scope {{byScope}} · text fingerprint {{byTextFingerprint}} · unmatched {{unmatched}} · daily summaries dropped {{summaries}}
erase.auditLine: Channel audit {{entries}} entries / {{files}} log files · runtime log {{lines}} lines · external chat observations {{chats}} · agent runs {{runs}}
erase.backupsLine: Memory + reconciliation backups: {{files}} files · {{size}} — destroyed as a whole, so nothing can be rolled back from them
erase.apiLogLine: API debug log (chat-api.log): {{size}} — destroyed as a whole; it contains the full prompt text of every model call
erase.entitiesTitle: Entity graph candidates ({{count}}, exact name match)
erase.residuesTitle: Possible leftovers (never modified automatically — confirm by hand): {{count}}
erase.previewFailedMessage: The preview did not finish, so nothing was executed: {{error}}
erase.confirmMessage: Erasing cannot be undone: it clears 「{{name}}」's traces in groups, private chats and zones and destroys memory backups and the debug log. What is kept on purpose (group corpus, desktop chats, run reviews/tool outputs, access config) is listed in the preview. Type 「{{phrase}}」 to continue:
erase.needsReconfirm: {{count}} new memories about them appeared after the preview, so nothing was deleted this time. Preview again before confirming.
erase.reconfirmLimitReached: {{count}} new memories about them appeared after the preview and several rounds in a row failed the consistency check. Aborted; please try again later.
erase.reportPartial: ⚠️ Partially completed: {{count}} steps failed. Running the erasure again converges (it is idempotent).
erase.reportL2: Memories: requested {{requested}} · removed {{removed}} · summaries removed {{summaries}} · de-compressed {{decompressed}}
erase.reportTranscript: Transcript: {{sessions}} sessions · hot {{hot}} lines · archive {{archive}} lines ({{assistant}} of them are her replies mentioning him)
erase.reportVectors: Vectors: memory vectors {{vectors}} · conversation vectors {{chatVectors}} (both channels must be cleared, or the data stays recallable)
erase.reportPeripheral: Audit {{entries}} entries / {{files}} files · runtime log {{lines}} lines · external chat observations {{chats}} · agent runs {{runs}} · backups {{backups}} files ({{backupSize}}) · debug log: {{apiLog}}
erase.reportRelationship: Relationship log: by person {{byPersonKey}} · by scope {{byScope}} · text fingerprint {{byTextFingerprint}} · summaries {{summaries}}
erase.reportCaches: Caches: recalled injections {{injections}} · session index {{sessionIndex}} · DMAE engine: {{dmae}}
erase.reportObsidianSynced: synced (orphan notes removed via the manifest)
erase.executeFailedMessage: The erasure aborted with an error (safe to retry; erasure is idempotent): {{error}}

zones.heading: Memory zones
zones.subheading: Chats in the same zone share memory. Different zones cannot see each other.
zones.empty: This zone has no members yet
zones.pickMemberDesc: Pick an external chat to join "{{zone}}". Desktop chats always belong to the desktop zone.
zones.pickMemberEmpty: No external chat available yet (only chats that already talked to Cyrene show up here). To add a brand-new group, use "Add group manually" on the zone card.

manualGroup.buttonHint: For groups that never talked to Cyrene: type the group ID to join this zone (= add it to the group allowlist)
manualGroup.pickChannelDesc: Pick the channel this group belongs to, then enter its ID to join "{{zone}}". Joining a zone = joining that channel's group allowlist.
manualGroup.pickChannelEmpty: No channel supports manual group entry

channel.qqNote: Enter the QQ group number, e.g. 123456789
channel.qqbotNote: Enter the group openid (not the group number)

message.qq: Enter the QQ group number (5-12 digits). Once added, Cyrene will see and answer messages in this group.
message.qqbot: Enter the group openid (not the group number — the QQ official bot only accepts openids; copy a rejected openid from the channel console in "Connect phone").

manualGroup.errorFormat: Invalid group ID: a QQ group number is 5-12 digits, a QQ bot group needs an openid
manualGroup.added: Group {{chatId}} joined this zone (= added to the group allowlist)
manualGroup.addedMoved: Group {{chatId}} moved into this zone (was in "{{from}}")

zones.moveDesc: Move the {{count}} selected member(s) to the target zone; a chat lives in exactly one zone.

delete.title: Delete zone
delete.message: Delete zone "{{name}}"? Its members return to standalone memory; no memory data is migrated.

zoneMigration.desc: Group access has moved to "Memory zones". Adding a group to a zone whitelists it; for a new group that never talked to Cyrene, use "Add group manually" on the zone card.
